meta.source_policy: Every figure in `products[*].terms`, `collateral`, `eligibility` and `required_documents` was read from PPCBank's own public product pages on the verified_on date. Everything under `business_type_profiles`, `demand_signals` and `ai_evaluation` is analyst heuristics, not bank policy. Rates and limits change; confirm with a branch before quoting a customer.
meta.currency_note: Amounts are in USD unless stated. Several products are offered in KHR as well as USD. Annatean Rohas is KHR only.
meta.data_safety: This file contains only public product information. No customer or transaction data.

products.name: SME 100
products.purpose: Start, expand or sustain a small business with a low fixed-rate loan.
products.description: Entry-level SME term loan for micro and small businesses and for people starting their first business. Fixed 7.5% per year, principal grace period up to 24 months, and a fast decision (2 business days; PPCBank's page also states 48 hours for loans up to USD 50,000). The catch is collateral: it needs a hard land or building title, so businesses that rent and own no titled property usually cannot use it.

ai_evaluation.purpose: Given a detected business or place, rank PPCBank loan products by likely fit and explain why, using only public signals.

pipeline.name: classify
pipeline.description: Map the place's OSM tags (or Google Places types) to one `business_type_profiles[*].id`. If nothing matches, use `unknown` and rely on the generic rules.

pipeline.name: score
pipeline.description: Start from the profile's `recommended[*].fit`, then adjust with `score_adjustments` using observed public signals.

pipeline.name: explain
pipeline.description: Ask the LLM for a short loan-officer brief using the prompt template. The LLM may reorder and explain but must not invent figures, products or eligibility.

hard_rules.rule: SME 100, SME 300, SME 700, SME 1000 and all Business Loan tiers require hard-title land or building. If the business is clearly a tenant with no titled property, demote these and prefer business_car_loan (vehicle security) or loan_against_deposit (deposit security).
Respect amount bands: SME 100 up to 100k; SME 300 100,001 to 300k; SME 700 300,001 to 700k; SME 1000 700,001 to 1m; Miro up to 10k; Small 10k to 50k; Medium 50k to 500k; Large over 500k.
car_for_cash is available in the Phnom Penh area only.

Personal products (home_loan, home_improvement_loan, car_loan_personal, car_for_cash, songkhoem_loan, annatean_rohas) apply to individuals. For a business place, treat them as cross-sell to the owner or staff, not as the main recommendation.
songkhoem_loan only applies to people going to South Korea to work or study.
Quote rates, limits and tenors only from `products[*].terms`. Say 'not published' when a field is null.

fit_scale.85_100: Strong fit. Lead with this product.
fit_scale.70_84: Good fit. Offer as primary or strong secondary.
fit_scale.50_69: Possible fit. Only if conditions are confirmed.
fit_scale.below_50: Weak fit. Do not recommend unless the owner asks.

prompt.system: You are an assistant for PPCBank loan officers in Cambodia. You help rank PPCBank loan products for a business that was found from public data (OpenStreetMap, public reviews). You never see customer or transaction data. You MUST only use the product facts supplied in <products>. Never invent rates, limits, tenors, eligibility rules or product names. If a fact is missing, say 'not published'. Public signals are weak evidence: say what is unknown (ownership of premises, income, collateral) and what the officer should verify. Return valid JSON matching the output schema and nothing else.
prompt.user_template:
<business>
name: {{name}}
osm_tags: {{osm_tags}}
address_area: {{area}}
opened_or_first_seen: {{first_seen}}
review_summary: {{review_summary}}
observed_signals: {{signals}}
</business>
<profile>{{matched_business_type_profile}}</profile>
<products>{{candidate_products_json}}</products>
Task: Rank the top 3 products for this business, with a fit score from 0 to 100 for each, one-sentence rationale, the main condition to verify, and the cross-sell opportunities. Respect the hard rules supplied. Keep the whole brief under 150 words.

verify.description: Single most important condition for the officer to confirm

guardrails: Only public data goes into the prompt. Never include customer or transaction data.
Present results as a lead hint for the loan officer, not a credit decision.
Re-check rates and limits against PPCBank's pages periodically; this file is a snapshot.
